# Intentionally rejected source import

This directory exists only on an unmerged demonstration PR. Do not merge it
or compile it into the firmware.

`py32f071.c` is an unmodified copy of
[`MCKero6423/uv-k5-v3-emulator/qemu/py32f071.c`](https://github.com/MCKero6423/uv-k5-v3-emulator/blob/ab84ee1fb8e0957fbf469c85c4b12dcc4e747395/qemu/py32f071.c)
at revision `ab84ee1fb8e0957fbf469c85c4b12dcc4e747395`.
Its upstream Git blob is `20d9920ea9113e680445c78a14c67d42f2c7749d`.
All original notices and the complete source file are preserved.

The file explicitly states "This code is licensed under the GPL version 2
or later." That specific grant is not replaced by this project's root
Apache-2.0 license or the upstream emulator's root Apache-2.0 license.

`COPYING` contains the GNU General Public License version 2 text, copied
unchanged from
[`qemu/qemu/COPYING`](https://github.com/qemu/qemu/blob/b67b00e6b4c7831a3f5bc684bc0df7a9bfd1bd56/COPYING)
at QEMU 7.2 revision `b67b00e6b4c7831a3f5bc684bc0df7a9bfd1bd56`.
The machine source's "or later" grant remains unchanged.

The source depends on QEMU interfaces not vendored here. This source-only
demonstration neither builds nor distributes a QEMU binary.
